name: Pre-Boss
triggeredBy: Fighting The Grand Thunder Bird, King Slime, or Eye of Cthulhu
description: You have not fought a boss or event yet and have explored the easy areas - Surface, Cavern, Tundra, and Ocean. Gear is ore, gems, and simple crafted upgrades.
cues: You have not defeated any boss yet.
You are gathering ore, gems, and early Thorium materials.
Notable threats: The Grand Thunder Bird, King Slime, Eye of Cthulhu, and the Blood Moon.
blurb: Ore and gem gear, before any boss.
guideNote: This section assumes the player hasn't fought any bosses or events yet and has explored easily accessible areas.

name: Pre-Eater of Worlds / Brain of Cthulhu
triggeredBy: Defeating the Eater of Worlds or the Brain of Cthulhu
description: You are preparing to fight your world's evil boss for its Demonite or Crimtane and the Shadow or Crimson gear that follows.
cues: You have beaten an early boss such as Eye of Cthulhu.
You are farming the Corruption or Crimson for evil-biome materials.
Your next goal is the Eater of Worlds or the Brain of Cthulhu.
blurb: Evil-biome gear on the way to the world evil boss.
guideNote: This section assumes the player has defeated the games earlier bosses and events and has obtained access to their proceeding loot.

name: Mid Pre-Hardmode
triggeredBy: Clearing the mid pre-Hardmode side bosses
description: The evil boss is down. You take on the ocean, bee, and side bosses for stronger class gear before the Dungeon.
cues: You have defeated your world evil boss.
You are fighting side bosses such as Queen Jellyfish, Deerclops, and Queen Bee.
You are building toward Skeletron and the Dungeon.
blurb: Side-boss gear between the evil boss and Skeletron.
guideNote: This section assumes the player has defeated the games bosses and events found in the middle of prehardmode and has obtained access to their proceeding loot.

name: Pre-Skeletron
description: You are gearing up to beat Skeletron and open the Dungeon, where new materials and gear wait.
cues: You have cleared the mid pre-Hardmode side bosses.
You may fight The Viscount for Crimson-themed gear.
You are preparing for Skeletron so you can enter the Dungeon.
blurb: Gear on the way to Skeletron and the Dungeon.
guideNote: This section assumes the player has defeated all bosses and events in Prehardmode prior to Skeletron and retrieved their proceeding loot.

name: Pre-Wall of Flesh
description: The Dungeon is open and the Underworld matters. You gather Hellstone and Dungeon gear before the boss that starts Hardmode.
cues: Skeletron is defeated and the Dungeon is part of your route.
You may fight the Granite Energy Storm, Buried Champion, and Star Scouter.
Hellstone and Underworld farming feed your last pre-Hardmode upgrades.
blurb: Dungeon and Underworld gear, prepping for the Wall of Flesh.
guideNote: This section assumes the player has defeated all bosses and events in Prehardmode prior to the Wall of Flash and retrieved their proceeding loot.

name: Post-Wall of Flesh
description: Hardmode has begun. New ores and enemies appear, and you fight the early Hardmode bosses for your first Hardmode class gear.
cues: The Wall of Flesh is dead and the world is now in Hardmode.
Hardmode ores can be mined after smashing altars.
You are fighting the Borean Strider, Fallen Beholder, and Queen Slime.
blurb: Early Hardmode ore and boss gear.
guideNote: This section assumes the player has defeated the Wall of Flesh and is now exploring the world in Hardmode.

name: Pre-Mechanical Bosses
description: You are preparing for the three Mechanical Bosses, which gate Hallowed-tier gear and the next progression step.
cues: Hardmode ore gear is crafted and you are ready for a mech fight.
You may repeat the early Hardmode bosses for upgrades.
Your goal is The Twins, The Destroyer, and Skeletron Prime.
blurb: Hardmode ore gear before the Mechanical Bosses.
guideNote: This section assumes the player has thoroughly explored the world in Hardmode and has defeated early hardmode bosses and events.

name: Post-Mechanical Bosses
triggeredBy: Defeating the post-mech bosses through Duke Fishron
description: The mechs are down. Hallowed gear and Plantera-tier progression open up, along with Thorium's Lich and Forgotten One.
cues: All three Mechanical Bosses are defeated.
You fight Lich, Plantera, Golem, and the Forgotten One.
You may take on the Empress of Light and Duke Fishron for their gear.
guideNote: This section assumes the player has thoroughly explored the world in Hardmode and has defeated the previous notable boss fights.

name: Pre-Lunar Invasion
description: Late-Hardmode gear is online. You clear event and Temple content before opening the Lunar Events with the Lunatic Cultist.
cues: Golem and the post-mech bosses are behind you.
Event and Temple farming polish your build.
Your goal is the Lunatic Cultist and the Celestial Pillars.
blurb: Late-Hardmode gear before the Lunar Events.
guideNote: This section assumes the player has defeated the previous notable boss fights and events.

name: Pre-Primordials
description: The Lunar Events and Moon Lord are cleared. Luminite gear and Thorium's endgame materials prepare you for The Primordials.
cues: The Lunatic Cultist is dead and the Celestial Pillars are appearing.
Moon Lord and its Luminite are within reach.
You are building toward Thorium's final fight, The Primordials.
blurb: Luminite and endgame gear before The Primordials.
guideNote: This section assumes the player has defeated the previous notable boss fights and events.

name: Endgame
description: The Primordials have fallen. The focus shifts to best-in-slot gear, completion goals, and optional challenge runs.
cues: The Primordials are defeated and the strongest gear is in reach.
You are polishing loadouts rather than unlocking new tiers.
Remaining goals are optimization, events, and challenge runs.
guideNote: This section assumes the player has defeated every threat and area in the game that Vanilla or the Thorium Mod has to offer.
